name: spectacle-lens-defaults
citation: Design defaults named in the master plan (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-26-master-plan.md, Task 3.5); not physiological constants.
vertexNote: Back vertex of the lens to the anterior corneal vertex; a common fitting distance.
indexNote: Crown-glass/CR-39-class index; the material is modeled without dispersion (approximation).
semiDiameterNote: Lens aperture radius, large enough for any eye pupil and gaze used here.
